item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight, expect partly to mostly cloudy skies across the region with low temperatures ranging from the mid-twenties to the lower thirties and only a slight chance of precipitation. Tomorrow brings mostly clear to partly cloudy conditions, with high temperatures in the upper thirties to near forty and virtually no precipitation expected. Tomorrow night stays mostly clear and cold, with lows dropping into the mid-teens to lower twenties and dry weather continuing.
